title: DeviceRegistrationResponse
description: server -> device, the 200 body of POST /devices/register (device-registration.schema.json). `connector_url` is the phone's secret MCP connector URL — present only when this call created the device, and never returned again: the server keeps only a hash of the secret inside it. A device that registers again with the same key (200, no `connector_url`) and has lost the URL recovers by connecting and sending `regenerate_secret`. Other statuses: 400 invalid body (including a public_key that is not an EC P-256 SPKI key, or a device_id that is not the one derived from it), 429 registration rate limit (Retry-After header).

device_id.description: The id derived from the registered key: "dt_" + lowercase hex SHA-256 of the SPKI DER bytes. The device uses this value in hello.

connector_url.description: The full URL to paste into an MCP client, secret included. Treat as a credential.
